users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Manage who can access ProcessHub and what they can do.
users.resetPasswordText: The user will be signed out everywhere and must use the new password.
users.deactivateText: The user will be signed out immediately and will not be able to sign in.
users.jobRolesHint: Roles from the Roles library. The Knowledge Portal shows the user the processes in which these roles perform steps (“My processes”).
users.resetMfaText: Use this when the user lost their phone. Their authenticator and recovery codes are removed and they are signed out everywhere. If their role requires 2FA, they set it up again at the next sign-in.

departments.title: Departments
departments.subtitle: Organisation structure used for users and process ownership.
departments.deleteText: Departments with sub-departments, users or processes cannot be deleted.
departments.managerHint: Overdue issues and actions of the department's staff are escalated to this person.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every sign-in and every change, with who made it and when.
audit.empty: No audit entries match the filters
audit.searchPlaceholder: Search user email, record or IP

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Organisation branding, language and integrations.
settings.defaultLanguageHint: Used on the sign-in page and for users who have not chosen a language.
settings.logoHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, up to 1 MB. Square images work best.

git.intro: Publish BPMN models (.bpmn + .json) and documentation pages (Markdown) to a GitHub or GitLab repository. ProcessHub keeps working exactly the same when this is switched off.
git.baseUrlGithub: Leave empty for github.com. GitHub Enterprise: https://your-host/api/v3
git.baseUrlGitlab: Leave empty for gitlab.com. Self-hosted: https://gitlab.your-company.com
git.folderHint: Folder inside the repository; empty = repository root.
git.tokenHintGithub: Fine-grained token with “Contents: read and write” on this repository.
git.tokenHintGitlab: Project or personal access token with the “api” scope (Developer role or higher).
git.tokenStored: A token is stored (encrypted). Leave empty to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.
git.removeTokenText: Synchronisation is switched off until a new token is entered.
git.noEncryptionKey: INTEGRATIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not configured on the server, so tokens cannot be stored. See the README.
git.oneWay: One-way: ProcessHub → Git. Changes made in the repository are not imported.
git.statusSubtitle: What was synchronised to the repository, and what failed.
git.disabledInfo: Git synchronisation is switched off. Enable it in Settings → Integrations.
git.publishedOnlyHint: Export only the officially published version of each process and page. Unpublished items are not exported (and are removed if they were exported before).
git.keyBackup: Access tokens and the SMTP password are encrypted with INTEGRATIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY (with Docker Compose it is generated in the api-data volume). Back it up together with the database: if it is lost or changes, stored tokens and passwords must be entered again.

email.title: Email (SMTP)
email.intro: Notification emails are sent through this SMTP server in each recipient's language. Users choose which notifications they receive by email in their profile.
email.passwordStored: A password is stored (encrypted). Leave empty to keep it.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.noEncryptionKey: INTEGRATIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set: the client secret cannot be stored and 2FA cannot be turned on.
auth.localLoginForced: AUTH_FORCE_LOCAL_LOGIN is set on the server: password sign-in is allowed for everyone. Remove it once the emergency is over.
auth.ssoIntro: Let staff sign in with their Microsoft 365 / Entra ID account or any other OpenID Connect provider. Register ProcessHub as an application at the provider with the redirect URI below.
auth.tenantIdHint: Entra admin center → Overview → Tenant ID (a GUID).
auth.tenantIdInvalid: Enter the tenant ID (GUID), not the domain name
auth.secretStored: A secret is stored (encrypted). Leave empty to keep it; type a new one to replace it.
auth.redirectUriHint: Register exactly this address at the provider (Entra ID: Authentication → Web → Redirect URIs).
auth.buttonLabelHint: Optional, e.g. "Sign in with Contoso account".
auth.allowedDomainsHint: Only addresses in these domains can sign in, e.g. contoso.com. Press Enter after each domain.
auth.autoCreateHint: Off: only users that already exist in ProcessHub (same e-mail) can sign in.
auth.groupsClaimHint: Name of the claim that lists the user’s groups (Entra ID: groups — turn on "groups claim" in Token configuration).
auth.groupMappingsHint: Directory group (Entra ID: group object ID) → ProcessHub roles and department. Roles of all matching groups are combined; users in no mapped group get the default role.
auth.syncRolesHint: Recommended: off — roles are managed in ProcessHub and the mappings only set the first role of a new user. On: the directory manages roles (changes made in ProcessHub are replaced at the next sign-in).
auth.localLogin: Allow sign-in with a ProcessHub password
auth.localLoginHint: Turn off when everyone uses single sign-on.
auth.breakGlassWarning: Only the break-glass account below can still sign in with a password. Keep its password and recovery codes in a safe place.
auth.breakGlassHint: A dedicated, active Super Admin with a password, for emergencies (for example the identity provider is down). Two-step verification is always required for this account.
auth.mfaRolesHint: Members of these roles must set up an authenticator app at their next password sign-in. Single sign-on users verify at the identity provider (Conditional Access).
auth.mfaAdminsWarning: Company policy requires two-step verification for Super Admin and Admin. Keep both roles in this list.

theme.title: Diagram colours
theme.intro: New diagram elements get the colour of their kind. Colours are stored in the diagram as standard BPMN colours (BPMN-in-Color), so they also show in other BPMN tools. Elements with their own colours keep them.

kind.systemTask: System task (service, send, script, business rule)

theme.resetConfirm: Use the default colours again? Existing diagrams keep their colours.
theme.unsaved: Save the colours before applying them to existing diagrams.
theme.applyHint: “Apply theme to existing diagrams” colours the elements that have no colour in every working model. Drafts get a new version “Applied colour theme”. Approved and published processes keep their status when only colours change (version “Theme applied (colours only)”, the portal shows the colours at once). Colours chosen by users are never changed. Processes in review or archived are skipped.
theme.applyTitle: Apply the colour theme to existing diagrams?
theme.applyText: {{elements}} elements without a colour in {{models}} diagrams will be coloured. Each changed diagram is saved as a new version.
theme.applyPublished_one: {{count}} approved or published process has other unpublished changes and gets a new draft. The published version stays in the portal until it is published again.
theme.applyPublished_other: {{count}} approved or published processes have other unpublished changes and get a new draft. The published versions stay in the portal until they are published again.
theme.applySkipped_one: {{count}} process in review or archived is skipped.
theme.applySkipped_other: {{count}} processes in review or archived are skipped.
theme.applyInPlace_one: {{count}} approved or published process changes in colours only: it keeps its status, gets a version “Theme applied (colours only)” and the portal shows the colours at once.
theme.applyInPlace_other: {{count}} approved or published processes change in colours only: they keep their status, get a version “Theme applied (colours only)” and the portal shows the colours at once.
theme.notice: Diagrams can now be coloured: run Apply theme.
theme.noticeDetail_one: {{count}} existing diagram has no colours yet. Settings → Diagram colours → “Apply theme to existing diagrams” colours it (with a preview of what changes).
theme.noticeDetail_other: {{count}} existing diagrams have no colours yet. Settings → Diagram colours → “Apply theme to existing diagrams” colours them (with a preview of what changes).

conventions.title: Modeling conventions
conventions.subtitle: House rules for diagrams: enabled rules show as warnings in the Validation panel; mandatory rules must pass before a process can be submitted for review.
conventions.footnote: The rules apply to all processes. Processes already in review or published are not affected until their next submission.

bilingualLabels.title: Labels in both languages
bilingualLabels.hint: Every step has a label in English and in Arabic.

laneRole.title: Steps in a lane linked to a role
laneRole.hint: Every step sits in a lane, and the lane is linked to a role from the library.

userTaskDescription.title: User tasks are described
userTaskDescription.hint: Every user task has a description (in either language).

maxElements.title: Diagram size
maxElements.hint: A diagram has at most the number of elements below (events, steps and decisions); split larger processes into sub-processes.

noUnconnected.title: No unconnected elements
noUnconnected.hint: Every element is connected to the flow.

approvalDecision.title: Approval followed by a decision
approvalDecision.hint: An approval step leads straight into a decision (gateway) with its outcomes, such as approved / returned / rejected.

salesforce.title: Salesforce KPI link
salesforce.subtitle: Read-only import of the corporate KPI catalogue and its results from the PMS app
salesforce.cardHint: Import KPI definitions and actual values from Salesforce (read-only, off by default).
salesforce.noKey: INTEGRATIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set: credentials cannot be stored.
salesforce.secretStored: Stored encrypted — leave empty to keep it.
salesforce.readOnly: ProcessHub only reads from Salesforce (SOQL queries); it never writes. Use a dedicated integration user with a read-only permission set.
salesforce.mappingHint: Salesforce API names; use “Load fields” to pick from the object.

objectiveSources.OBJECT: Their own object (lookup on the KPI)
objectiveSources.KPI_FIELD: The values of a KPI field (picklist)

salesforce.valueMapHint: One per line: Salesforce value = ProcessHub value

valueMaps.periodValues: Period values (Q1…Q4, H1 / H2, M01…M12, YEAR)

salesforce.includeUnapprovedHint: Off: only period results with the approval checkbox set are imported.
salesforce.syncOnly: Only a Super Admin changes the connection and mapping. You can preview and run the sync and review the sync log.
salesforce.valueLinks: Link picklist values to existing objectives
salesforce.valueLinksHint: Values not linked here become new objectives on the next sync.
